contrary_evidence: IEA WEO 2026 supports the cumulative Gulf losses of 2.8 billion barrels of oil and 60 bcm of gas, the 7 mb/d bypass-pipeline figure, the USD 40 billion construction estimate and the 25 million km/15 million km grid requirements.
The EIA report for the week ending 13 November, released 18 November, confirms crude inventories rose 3.4 million barrels to 417.8 million barrels.
Eurostat confirms October euro-area HICP at 4.0% and the 1.89 percentage-point energy contribution.
The World Bank confirms developing-country external debt at USD 9.4 trillion in 2025, up 5.5%.
limitations: The exact public release hour of the IEA World Energy Outlook 2026 is not displayed on the public report page; the producer relies on a separate embargo advisory.
IEA scenarios and system requirements are conditional, not realised infrastructure or committed capital.
Treasury par yields do not measure private credit spreads or project-finance margins.
The strict editorial-depth workflow has repository-wide failures on seven other staged items; this candidate was not one of them.
